ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light-gray) field across the central surface contrasted with a low-intensity (black/dark-gray) border along the trailing edge and distal tips, approximately an 85:15 distribution ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Light-gray base layer; low-intensity contiguous band along the trailing edge; isolated low-intensity circular ring clusters in the upper-left lobe; vertical low-intensity linear streaks extending from the trailing edge near the central notch and mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression at the central axis with a calculated divergence angle of approximately 75-80 degrees between the inner lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude jaggedness along the interior lobes, transitioning to high-amplitude, coarse serrations and irregular protrusions toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex curvature of the trailing edges originating from the central notch and extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, high-texture white/tan circular rosettes on both distal tips; multiple low-intensity circular ring markings distributed across the interior of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions extending from the trailing edge into the lighter ventral field, specifically near the central notch and the medial portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonization on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; irregular notches and jagged edge loss along the trailing boundary indicative of environmental wear or past mechanical impact.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark circular ring-like pigmentations on the left fluke lobe and prominent dark vertical 'drip' patterns near the central notch area.
